messages:
Carla-Sec: quick heads-up — discovered a partner webhook payload in GCS that contained a base64 blob looking like a wrapped service key. not public but accessible by a staging job. starting a triage.
Bob-Ops: ouch. can you paste the path?
Carla-Sec: gs://redwood-partner-logs/2026-03-20/ingest-12345.log -> lines ~120-125. the blob decodes to a ciphertext that looks KMS-wrapped. i grabbed a snippet and redacted it.
Alice-Eng: do we know which SA that key corresponds to? any live creds?
Carla-Sec: initial check: the SA referenced was projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com — it has limited perms (storage read/write to partner buckets). still, we should rotate and audit who has that key.
Dave-Platform: tagging infra-bot to revoke any active tokens for that SA and create ephemeral fallback. @infra-bot revoke-sa-tokens partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
infra-bot: Received: revoke-sa-tokens partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Starting revocation job. ETA ~45s. (job id: revoke-315555) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Bob-Ops: good. also we need to check Vault for any mapped secrets or wrapped blobs — could be a backup artifact. Carla, can you confirm if the ciphertext matches our KMS key IDs?
Carla-Sec: partial match to projects/redwood-keys/locations/global/keyRings/kr-prod/cryptoKeys/ck-ingest, but it might be a copy. i've placed the redacted lines in #sec-evidence-private.
Alice-Eng: two parallel actions: 1) rotate SA keys / create new SA with least privilege + update partner onboarding to use ephemeral tokens; 2) run RBAC audit for any principals that can decrypt with ck-ingest and block historical access where appropriate.
Carla-Sec: agree. timeline suggestion: immediate revoke + emergency rotation now, RBAC audit within 24h, audit log retention check and export to SCC for compliance.
Jess-Compliance: please include me on audit exports. we need to freeze retention policy for this bucket and snapshot logs for legal.
Dave-Platform: i'm running a quick gcloud to list who has kms.cryptoKeyVersions.use or iam.roles that allow decryption:``` 
# quick ACL check
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ck-ingest --keyring=kr-prod --location=global --project=redwood-keys
``` 
Bob-Ops: add a second layer: turn on KMS audit logging at the key ring level (if not already) and enable log-based alerts for decrypt calls from unfamiliar service accounts.
Alice-Eng: also check Vault: any wrapped values stored under secret/partner/*? If so, we should rewrap with a new key after rotation. Carla, can you grep Vault audit for partner-ingest SA usage?
Carla-Sec: on it. running `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault-audit.log` is already set in prod. searching now.
(inline) Carla-Sec: found 3 reads by partner-ingest from secret/partner/config in last 7 days. two of those show wrapped ciphertext versions. grabbing the paths for rotation list.
Dave-Platform: plan for rotation: 1) create new SA or new key version, 2) update partner onboarding to request short-lived tokens (workload identity) and revoke long-lived keys, 3) rotate any Vault wrapped blobs to use the new KMS key version and update mounts.
Bob-Ops: reminder: coordinate with partner before revoking keys to avoid production breakage. do a staged rollout: canary to partner staging first.
Carla-Sec: i'll message partner PM now: "we detected a credential artifact in partner logs stored in staging bucket. we plan a rotation window in 1h. please confirm staging traffic can tolerate short downtime".
Partner-Reply (pasted by Carla-Sec): "ack, staging can accept a short window, please coordinate exact time"
infra-bot: revoke-315555 completed. active tokens for partner-ingest SA revoked. :white_check_mark:
Alice-Eng: ok live ops step: create new service account key version, bind only storage.objectViewer for partner buckets, and issue a workload-identity binding for the partner K8s cluster so they get token exchange instead of long keys.
Dave-Platform: i'll prepare terraform patch and a canary rollout plan. patch will add new SA, assign minimal IAM, create new KMS key version for wrap/unwrap, and rotate Vault entries in a maintenance window.
Bob-Ops: don't forget to run a secrets blast-radius list: `gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=*` is dangerous — instead use our inventory tool: `./tools/secret-inventory --filter=partner-ingest` to find references across code, CI, and infra.
Carla-Sec: doing inventory scan now. found 4 references in infra repo, 1 in partner onboarding, 0 in public repos.
Alice-Eng: post-rotation checks: 1) confirm Vault unwrapped/wrapped entries use new key version, 2) confirm no decrypt logs from old SA or from unexpected principals, 3) monitor error rate in partner ingest for 2 hours.
Jess-Compliance: keep an export of all KMS decrypt logs for legal review. also need a short writeup of the incident and mitigation steps for the compliance ticket. cc @legal when you have it.
Carla-Sec: drafting a one-pager and safe timeline. will include commands we ran, token IDs revoked (`revoke-315555`), affected artifacts list, and the change PRs.
Alice-Eng: who owns the change PR? Dave?
Dave-Platform: i'll own the PR for terraform changes and the vault rewrap script. will tag Alice for code review and Bob for ops runbook updates.
Carla-Sec: final ask: after rotation, please run a short red-team test to attempt to access the rotated artifacts using any leaked blobs we saved for analysis (in an isolated lab). confirm impossible.
Bob-Ops: scheduled. will kick off tests 2 hours after rotation is fully validated.
Carla-Sec: thanks all. updating thread with final artifacts and the incident summary once complete. :lock:
Alice-Eng: great coordination. small follow-up: we should add an automated detector to flag KMS-wrapped-looking blobs in partner logs and block upload or quarantine. feature request ticket coming. :robot_face:
